preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, the length of the permutation n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= q_i <= n for q_i in q)
preconditions.description: Each element q_i in the array q must be between 1 and n.
The total sum of n across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the lexicographically minimal permutation must be equal to n.
The length of the lexicographically maximal permutation must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(minimal_permutation[i] <= maximal_permutation[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element of the minimal permutation must be less than or equal to the corresponding element of the maximal permutation.
